changes.description: Extracted the blog post layout into a dedicated BlogPostView component and added a sticky scroll-spy table of contents (B+C warm/hybrid design).
Updated the Orbit project link to the live application and removed the private repository reference.
Added Orbit project entry (draft) as the first project slot, bumping existing project IDs.
Fixed a hydration mismatch in the theme drawer caused by useThemeHook reading localStorage during server rendering.
Repaired lint script (now eslint src), fixed all standalone typecheck errors, and removed dead dependencies and stale Prisma configuration.
CI image publishing now waits for content validation to pass, and the ThemeAside state sync was simplified.
Redesigned the blog post header with responsive title sizing and a reading time badge, added an editorial drop cap on the first paragraph, and improved blockquote styling.
Replaced placeholder project copy and links for wowcomps and atomology, fixed a wowcomps tech typo and a stale language-services grammar typo.
Made the contact email consistent (now the real recipient) and added a /language-services call-to-action in the home hero for both target audiences.

Replaced the partial blog renderer with a controlled Markdown/MDX article component system covering headings with anchors, lists, links, emphasis, inline and fenced code, blockquotes, thematic dividers, and images.
Consolidated project-detail routing so /dev/[slug] is canonical, with /portfolio and /portfolio/[slug] preserved as redirects.
Draft posts and projects are now excluded from all public surfaces (indexes, carousels, navigation, RSS, sitemap, JSON-LD) and are not statically generated.
Completed the Build Real Life Projects blog post with personal examples from wowcomps and Orbit, plus practical guidance for using code and AI to build useful tools.
Completed the TypeScript Generics blog post with examples covering generic functions, constraints, reusable data shapes, classes, and API helpers.
Cleaned up blog post filenames and metadata, and moved unfinished posts to draft status.
Added Cabin Chat, picme, and wordweb. to /dev with project detail pages, screenshots, and content entries wired into the existing Contentlayer pipeline.
Added a full-screen image lightbox to project carousels with fade transitions, backdrop click-to-close, Escape support, and left/right arrow navigation between screenshots.
Introduced project image helpers to prefer 1.-prefixed screenshots for featured cards and sort gallery images in numeric order.
Redesigned /dev/[slug] gallery presentation with a 900×440 viewport: large images scale down to fit, smaller crops stay centered at native size, and dot controls sit below the image area.
Improved project carousel controls with larger dot pills, stable active/inactive sizing via transparent borders, cursor-pointer affordance, and removal of the bottom image fade overlay.
Updated /dev/[slug] metadata typography from mono to sans, matched stack tags to /dev card pill styling, and hid the Cabin Chat Live Demo button when no separate demo URL exists.
Linked Atomology, wowcomps, and new project screenshots from public/images/assets/projects using numbered filenames and updated content frontmatter paths.
Enhanced /contact form with inline email validation (check/X icons), character counter on message field, and animated paper-plane send button.
Added Korea National Pension Service Investment Management to the /language-services experience section.
Removed on-hover slide-in arrow icons from blog post cards on /blog. The static arrow in the featured card's 'Read full article' link remains.
Enhanced Hero avatar with glow shadow, mouse-tracking accent blob, hover scale, and warm color wash overlay.
Fixed layout shifting in /language-services services section by removing hover padding transition that caused text reflow.
Removed duplicate project markdown files that caused projects to appear twice on /dev.
Created dynamic /dev/[slug] project detail pages with an editorial, magazine-style design featuring staggered entrance animations, hairline meta strips, and previous/next navigation.
Redesigned Hero component with orbiting rings around the avatar, dramatic typography hierarchy, and staggered fade-in animations using the editorial index pattern.
Redesigned /language-services services section as a numbered index list with hairline dividers, per-service accent color hovers, and consistent editorial styling.
Added click-through navigation from project titles on /dev to their dedicated project detail pages.
Fixed ThemeDrawer alignment so the close button stays flush with the carousel container edge across all breakpoints.
fix/colors: updated some color themes, added five new themes to the app.
fix(docker): remove changelog from dockerignore so data is included in image
fix(docker): include changelog data in production image
Migrated to self-hosted deployment on a home lab server with automated CI/CD pipeline.
Implemented secure public exposure via Cloudflare Tunnel with no open inbound ports.
Established GitHub Actions workflow for automatic Docker image builds and homelab deployments on every master push.
Containerized the application with Docker Compose, healthchecks, and a dedicated non-root runtime user.
Redesigned the /language-services page with a bento-style services grid featuring icons, accent borders, and hover interactions.
Added an interactive left-rail timeline to the /language-services Experience section with a scroll-tracking fill indicator and a floating year pill.
Grouped experience items by year in the /language-services timeline with proportional segment heights and visual gaps between years.
Fixed mobile Navbar menu icons not displaying correctly in the hamburger menu.
Updated the Kharidian Dunes theme palette for improved contrast and visual consistency.
Typography pass across all pages: standardised H1 to text-4xl font-bold font-serif on /blog, /blog/[slug], /dev, /portfolio/[slug], /language-services, and /contact.

Fixed semantic HTML in /language-services: client name labels were incorrectly using

tags; changed to

with font-bold styling. 'Experience' section heading changed from

to

.
Added font-semibold to all heading levels in HeadingAnchor component used in blog and portfolio post content.
Redesigned blog post cards and project cards: each card is now fully clickable, slightly narrower (w-80), with increased gap between cards for a more spacious layout.
Added a right-arrow indicator to card CTAs to reinforce interactivity.
Blog post cards now show a local placeholder image when no post image is available, matching the existing behaviour of project cards.
Featured project cards on the home page now correctly show the placeholder image when no project image is declared, instead of a white box.

Added full CI/CD deployment pipeline: multi-stage Dockerfile (standalone output), docker-compose with Cloudflare Tunnel sidecar, and GitHub Actions workflows for build/push to GHCR and deploy to self-hosted homelab runner.
Added a monthly maintenance reminder workflow that automatically opens a GitHub issue with a checklist of routine site maintenance tasks.
Replaced Unsplash external fallback image with a local placeholder at /images/assets/placeholder.png used across all cards and as the default Open Graph image.
Fixed toAbsoluteUrl() to always return a fully qualified URL, preventing relative paths in Open Graph metadata.
Added /portfolio/[slug] static route with full project detail pages, generated at build time for all published projects.
Added redirect from /portfolio to /dev to avoid 404s on the old portfolio URL.
SITE_URL is now driven by the NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL environment variable with a fallback, making the app domain-agnostic and ready for deployment to any host.
Added .env.example documenting all required environment variables.
Fixed .gitignore to allow .env.example to be committed while still ignoring all real .env files.
Hero profile image now served from public/ directory instead of being bundled into the JavaScript output.
Made some adjustements to the blog post page to ensure that the hero image is always displayed if available, and falls back to a default image if not.
Fixed up typing issues between Contentlayer and the renderer in the blog post page.
Added h-20 to the Footer component to make it consistent with the Navbar.
Finally fleshed out the /language-servies page to include more details about the services I offer and my experience in the field.
Overhaul of several color themes to improve contrast and readability.
Removed some off-theme styling effects to keep the design clean and consistent.
Fixed the broken Navbar that would flicker on scroll while on smaller screens.
Redesigned the /blog and /dev views for a cleaner and more minimalistic look.
Fixed the broken palette drawer padding issues on larger screens.
Redesigned the /blog and /dev views for a cleaner and more minimalistic look.
Fixed the broken palette drawer padding issues on larger screens.
Cleaned up the /blog view to be clean and minimalistic so I can move on to the /dev view.
Refactored types for the headers that handle themes/cookies, etc.
Build on the `/blog` route to display the (for now) dummy data in card format.
Updated some colors to make for better visibility/separation, and added a divider to the Archive section.
Added the Changelog system to track updates made to the website and display them in `/dev` dynamically.
Updated border color for theme palettes to improve visibility.
Updated palette border styles for better visibility.
Corrected footer copyright year to start from 2020.
Began work on the Changelog system which will track updates made to the website and display them in `/dev`.
Added a theme selector with a range of WoW and OSRS inspired color palettes.
Enhanced theme application logic for better performance.
